name: The Magnum Ice Cream Company N.V.
sector: Consumer Staples / Ice cream & frozen desserts
moat_justification: World's largest ice cream company (~21% of the global retail ice cream market) with four power brands (Magnum, Ben & Jerry's, Cornetto, Heartbrand/Wall's), a proprietary freezer-cabinet estate and cold-chain scale no rival matches globally. Evidence: gross margin held 34.08% / 34.91% / 34.63% across FY2023-25 (fundamentals.json, as filed in EUR) through cocoa/dairy inflation, with +2.6% price growth AND +1.5% volume growth in FY2025 — real pricing power. The roic_proxy series in fundamentals.json reads 20.92% (FY2023) and 22.28% (FY2024), but those are carve-out years: invested capital carried almost no debt and Unilever allocated costs, so they overstate the standalone franchise; FY2025's 214.27% is a demerger artifact (equity fell to EUR 633M when EUR 2,967M of net debt was pushed onto the new balance sheet) and is not evidence. On a standalone capital base the true through-cycle ROIC is unproven — that, plus a category growing only 3-4%/yr, caps the score at 6 (moderate) rather than 7+.
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base

FX_CONVERTED: reporting currency EUR converted to USD at period-end ECB reference rates (frankfurter.app) — flow facts use the period-end rate, not a period average; the rates used are recorded in dcf_numbers.json fx_conversion

ADS_RATIO_APPLIED: 20-F filer — per-share figures scaled x1.0 ordinary shares per ADS (Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-18), cover page: securities registered under Section 12(b) are 'Ordinary Shares, nominal value EUR 3.50 per share', trading symbol MICC on the New York Stock Exchange; admission announcement 8 December 2025: issued share capital on admission was 612,259,739 ordinary shares admitted to trading on Euronext Amsterdam, the London Stock Exchange and the NYSE, with DTC accounts credited with interests in TMICC ordinary shares — the NYSE security is the ordinary share itself) so they are comparable to the ADS price; TTM pins are taken as per-ADS already
THIN_HISTORY: only 3 fiscal years of data

DEBT_TAGS_BLANK: no debt tag reports for the latest fiscal year — net debt is UNKNOWN (not zero); no leverage verdict is possible from the engine, state the balance sheet from the filing in analysis.md

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:shares — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (estimate: Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-03-18), EPS note (Annual Report p.115): average number of shares 612.3M basic, plus 3.3M dilutive effect of share-based compensation plans = 615.6M diluted average for 2025; the note states the 2025 average equals the shares outstanding at 31 December 2025 and that no EPS was calculated for prior years); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
BASE_DIVERGENCE: latest FY OE/share 0.17 vs 3-yr median 1.11 — one of them is distorted; find out which and why
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (7.3%) vs bull-case tier C (10.8%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: World's largest ice cream company (Magnum, Ben & Jerry's, Cornetto, Wall's/Heartbrand), moat 6/10 — does not clear 15% at $18.78: weighted IRR 9.14% (Tier D; bear-to-bull band D to C), weighted IV@15% $9.84; clears 15% only below ~$9.84, and even the $1.11 pro-forma median base is a carve-out construct — the first standalone year (FY2025) printed OE/share of $0.17 after separation costs and new standalone interest, so the honest range runs from deep-D on the latest year to D on the median.
exit_alert_suppressed_reason: tier exists only because of a judgment override
moat_for: Global scale leader: ~21% share of the global retail ice cream market, #1 position, 30 factories — procurement and cold-chain cost advantage

Power-brand portfolio: Magnum, Ben & Jerry's, Cornetto and the Heartbrand (Wall's) — proven pricing power (+2.6% price with +1.5% volume in FY2025; gross margin stable ~34-35% through commodity inflation)
Proprietary freezer-cabinet estate and route-to-market in impulse channels — physical distribution moat competitors must rent or replicate
Innovation cadence: 150 launches in 2025 (Magnum Utopia, Cornetto Max, Bonbons bites) driving high-single-digit organic growth in the Magnum and Cornetto brands
moat_against: Category grows only 3-4%/yr and faces a structural GLP-1 appetite headwind; private label and Froneri (valued ~EUR 15B in Oct 2025) contest every shelf

Standalone economics unproven: carve-out ROIC (20.9%/22.3%) was earned on a debt-free allocated capital base; the listed company carries EUR 2,967M net debt (2.4x adjusted EBITDA) and structurally higher standalone costs (interest paid EUR 130M in FY2025)
Unilever retains 19.9% and has committed to sell it within five years (registered for resale April 2026) — a persistent share overhang

Ben & Jerry's governance conflict inherited at the demerger: independent board removed, co-founder resigned Sept 2025, federal litigation live, a founder buy-back campaign valuing the brand at $1.5-2B
Commodity exposure (cocoa, dairy, sugar) and emerging-market FX (incl. Turkiye hyperinflation loss EUR 31M in FY2025) squeeze the ~34.6% gross margin
